body.message:
Hi dear Tharushi,

For the next payment, I’m only willing to pay the same amount for the next three months. Could you please double-check with the owner this time and let me know? I’m happy to make the payment immediately once it’s confirmed.

To be transparent, I’ve received a lower offer from a place in the neighboring building, so I’d really appreciate it if the owner could match my current rate. I would prefer to stay here if we can agree on the same price.

Thank you!
